$comment: Index of Zabbix 7.0 API JSON Schemas. object -> method -> {path,title,description}.

action.get.title: action.get
action.get.description: Retrieve actions according to the given parameters.

alert.get.title: alert.get
alert.get.description: Retrieve alerts according to the given parameters.

apiinfo.version.title: apiinfo.version
apiinfo.version.description: Retrieve the version of the Zabbix API. Only available to unauthenticated users and must be called without the auth parameter in the JSON-RPC request.

auditlog.get.title: auditlog.get
auditlog.get.description: Retrieve audit log records according to the given parameters. Restricted to Super admin user types (permissions manageable via user role settings).

authentication.get.title: authentication.get
authentication.get.description: Retrieve authentication settings according to the given parameters. Only available to Super admin user type.

authentication.update.title: authentication.update
authentication.update.description: Update existing authentication settings. Only available to Super admin user type. There is a single, singleton Authentication object (no ID field); pass any subset of its properties to update.

autoregistration.get.title: autoregistration.get
autoregistration.get.description: Retrieve autoregistration settings. Restricted to users with Super admin status.

autoregistration.update.title: autoregistration.update
autoregistration.update.description: Update autoregistration settings. Restricted to users with Super admin status.

connector.get.title: connector.get
connector.get.description: Retrieve connectors according to the given parameters.

connector.update.title: connector.update
connector.update.description: Update existing connectors. Only the connectorid property is required; only passed properties are updated, the rest remain unchanged.

correlation.delete.title: correlation.delete
correlation.delete.description: Delete correlations. Params is an array of correlation IDs to delete.

correlation.get.title: correlation.get
correlation.get.description: Retrieve correlations according to the given parameters.

dashboard.get.title: dashboard.get
dashboard.get.description: Retrieve dashboards according to the given parameters.

dcheck.get.title: dcheck.get
dcheck.get.description: Retrieve discovery checks according to the given parameters.

dhost.get.title: dhost.get
dhost.get.description: Retrieve discovered hosts according to the given parameters.

discoveryrule.copy.title: discoveryrule.copy
discoveryrule.copy.description: Copy LLD rules with all of the prototypes to the given hosts. Deprecated: configure LLD rules on templates and link the templates to other templates/hosts instead.

discoveryrule.delete.title: discoveryrule.delete
discoveryrule.delete.description: Delete LLD rules. Accepts an array of LLD rule IDs to delete.

discoveryrule.get.title: discoveryrule.get
discoveryrule.get.description: Retrieve LLD rules according to the given parameters.

discoveryrule.update.title: discoveryrule.update
discoveryrule.update.description: Update existing LLD rules. The itemid property must be defined for each LLD rule; all other properties are optional and only passed properties will be updated.

drule.get.title: drule.get
drule.get.description: Retrieve network discovery rules according to the given parameters.

dservice.get.title: dservice.get
dservice.get.description: Retrieve discovered services according to the given parameters.

event.acknowledge.title: event.acknowledge
event.acknowledge.description: Update events: close, acknowledge/unacknowledge, add a message, change severity, suppress/unsuppress, or change event rank.

event.get.title: event.get
event.get.description: Retrieve events according to the given parameters.

graph.get.title: graph.get
graph.get.description: Retrieve graphs according to the given parameters.

graph.update.title: graph.update
graph.update.description: Update existing graphs. Only the graphid property is required; only passed properties are updated, the rest remain unchanged.

graphitem.get.title: graphitem.get
graphitem.get.description: Retrieve graph items according to the given parameters.

graphprototype.get.title: graphprototype.get
graphprototype.get.description: Retrieve graph prototypes according to the given parameters.

hanode.get.title: hanode.get
hanode.get.description: Retrieve a list of High availability cluster nodes according to the given parameters. Only available to Super admin user types.

history.get.title: history.get
history.get.description: Retrieve history data according to the given parameters. May return historical data of a deleted entity if this data has not been removed by the housekeeper yet.

history.push.title: history.push
history.push.description: Send item history data to Zabbix server. The IP address of the Zabbix web interface must be specified in the Allowed hosts field of the Zabbix trapper item in order for the method to work.

host.get.title: host.get
host.get.description: Retrieve hosts according to the given parameters.

host.massadd.title: host.massadd
host.massadd.description: Simultaneously add multiple related objects to all the given hosts.

host.massremove.title: host.massremove
host.massremove.description: Remove related objects from multiple hosts.

host.massupdate.title: host.massupdate
host.massupdate.description: Simultaneously replace or remove related objects and update properties on multiple hosts.

hostgroup.get.title: hostgroup.get
hostgroup.get.description: Retrieve host groups according to the given parameters.

hostgroup.massadd.title: hostgroup.massadd
hostgroup.massadd.description: Simultaneously add multiple related objects to all the given host groups.

hostgroup.massremove.title: hostgroup.massremove
hostgroup.massremove.description: Remove related objects from multiple host groups.

hostgroup.massupdate.title: hostgroup.massupdate
hostgroup.massupdate.description: Replace hosts and templates with the specified ones in multiple host groups.

hostgroup.propagate.title: hostgroup.propagate
hostgroup.propagate.description: Propagate permissions and tag filters to all subgroups of a host group.

hostinterface.get.title: hostinterface.get
hostinterface.get.description: Retrieve host interfaces according to the given parameters.

hostinterface.massadd.title: hostinterface.massadd
hostinterface.massadd.description: Simultaneously add host interfaces to multiple hosts.

hostinterface.massremove.title: hostinterface.massremove
hostinterface.massremove.description: Remove host interfaces from the given hosts.

hostinterface.replacehostinterfaces.title: hostinterface.replacehostinterfaces
hostinterface.replacehostinterfaces.description: Replace all host interfaces on a given host.

hostprototype.get.title: hostprototype.get
hostprototype.get.description: Retrieve host prototypes according to the given parameters.

housekeeping.get.title: housekeeping.get
housekeeping.get.description: Retrieve housekeeping object according to the given parameters.

httptest.get.title: httptest.get
httptest.get.description: Retrieve web scenarios according to the given parameters.

iconmap.get.title: iconmap.get
iconmap.get.description: Retrieve icon maps according to the given parameters.

image.get.title: image.get
image.get.description: Retrieve images according to the given parameters.

item.create.title: item.create
item.create.description: Create new items. Web items cannot be created via the Zabbix API.

item.delete.title: item.delete
item.delete.description: Delete items. IDs of the items to delete. Dependent items and item prototypes are removed automatically if the master item is deleted. Web items cannot be deleted via the Zabbix API.

item.get.title: item.get
item.get.description: Retrieve items according to the given parameters.

item.update.title: item.update
item.update.description: Update existing items. The itemid property must be defined for each item; all other properties are optional. Web items cannot be updated via the Zabbix API.

itemprototype.get.title: itemprototype.get
itemprototype.get.description: Retrieve item prototypes according to the given parameters.

maintenance.get.title: maintenance.get
maintenance.get.description: Retrieve maintenances according to the given parameters.

map.get.title: map.get
map.get.description: Retrieve maps according to the given parameters.

mediatype.get.title: mediatype.get
mediatype.get.description: Retrieve media types according to the given parameters.

mfa.get.title: mfa.get
mfa.get.description: Retrieve MFA methods according to the given parameters.

module.get.title: module.get
module.get.description: Retrieve modules according to the given parameters.

problem.get.title: problem.get
problem.get.description: Retrieve unresolved problems (and, if requested, recently resolved ones) according to the given parameters.

proxy.get.title: proxy.get
proxy.get.description: Retrieve proxies according to the given parameters.

proxygroup.get.title: proxygroup.get
proxygroup.get.description: Retrieve proxy groups according to the given parameters.

regexp.get.title: regexp.get
regexp.get.description: Retrieve global regular expressions according to the given parameters.

report.get.title: report.get
report.get.description: Retrieve scheduled reports according to the given parameters.

role.get.title: role.get
role.get.description: Retrieve user roles according to the given parameters.

script.execute.title: script.execute
script.execute.description: Run a script on a host or event. Except for URL type scripts, which are not executable.

script.get.title: script.get
script.get.description: Retrieve scripts according to the given parameters.

script.getscriptsbyevents.title: script.getscriptsbyevents
script.getscriptsbyevents.description: Retrieve all available scripts on the given event, or a specific script if a script ID is provided. When manualinput is provided, it substitutes the {MANUALINPUT} macro with the specified value.

script.getscriptsbyhosts.title: script.getscriptsbyhosts
script.getscriptsbyhosts.description: Retrieve all available scripts on the given host, or a specific script if a script ID is provided. When manualinput is provided, it substitutes the {MANUALINPUT} macro with the specified value.

script.update.title: script.update
script.update.description: Update existing scripts. The scriptid property must be defined for each script; all other properties are optional and only the passed properties will be updated. An exception is the type property change from 5 (Webhook) to other: the parameters property will be cleaned.

service.get.title: service.get
service.get.description: Retrieve services according to the given parameters.

settings.get.title: settings.get
settings.get.description: Retrieve the settings object according to the given parameters.

sla.get.title: sla.get
sla.get.description: Retrieve SLA objects according to the given parameters.

sla.getsli.title: sla.getsli
sla.getsli.description: Calculate the Service Level Indicator (SLI) data for a Service Level Agreement (SLA).

task.create.title: task.create
task.create.description: Create new tasks. Accepts a single task object or an array of task objects (bulk create).

task.get.title: task.get
task.get.description: Retrieve tasks according to the given parameters. Only available to Super admin user type.

template.delete.title: template.delete
template.delete.description: Delete templates. Deleting a template causes deletion of all template entities (items, triggers, graphs, etc.). To leave template entities with the hosts, unlink the template first via template.update, template.massupdate, host.update, or host.massupdate.

template.get.title: template.get
template.get.description: Retrieve templates according to the given parameters.

template.massadd.title: template.massadd
template.massadd.description: Simultaneously add multiple related objects to the given templates.

template.massremove.title: template.massremove
template.massremove.description: Remove related objects from multiple templates.

template.massupdate.title: template.massupdate
template.massupdate.description: Simultaneously replace or remove related objects and update properties on multiple templates.

templatedashboard.get.title: templatedashboard.get
templatedashboard.get.description: Retrieve template dashboards according to the given parameters.

templategroup.delete.title: templategroup.delete
templategroup.delete.description: Delete template groups. A template group cannot be deleted if it contains templates that belong to this group only.

templategroup.get.title: templategroup.get
templategroup.get.description: Retrieve template groups according to the given parameters.

templategroup.massadd.title: templategroup.massadd
templategroup.massadd.description: Simultaneously add multiple related objects to all the given template groups.

templategroup.massremove.title: templategroup.massremove
templategroup.massremove.description: Remove related objects from multiple template groups.

templategroup.massupdate.title: templategroup.massupdate
templategroup.massupdate.description: Replace templates with the specified ones in multiple template groups. All other templates, except the ones mentioned, will be excluded from the given template groups.

templategroup.propagate.title: templategroup.propagate
templategroup.propagate.description: Apply permissions to all of the given template groups' subgroups.

token.create.title: token.create
token.create.description: Create new tokens. A token created by this method also has to be generated (token.generate) before it is usable.

token.generate.title: token.generate
token.generate.description: Generate tokens. A token can be generated by this method only if it has been created (token.create) first.

token.get.title: token.get
token.get.description: Retrieve tokens according to the given parameters.

token.update.title: token.update
token.update.description: Update existing tokens. The tokenid property must be defined for each token; all other properties are optional and only passed properties will be updated.

trend.get.title: trend.get
trend.get.description: Retrieve trend data according to the given parameters.

trigger.delete.title: trigger.delete
trigger.delete.description: Delete triggers. IDs of the triggers to delete.

trigger.get.title: trigger.get
trigger.get.description: Retrieve triggers according to the given parameters.

triggerprototype.get.title: triggerprototype.get
triggerprototype.get.description: Retrieve trigger prototypes according to the given parameters.

user.checkAuthentication.title: user.checkAuthentication
user.checkAuthentication.description: Check and prolong the user session. Calling this method using the sessionid parameter prolongs the user session by default.

user.get.title: user.get
user.get.description: Retrieve users according to the given parameters.

user.login.title: user.login
user.login.description: Log in to the API and generate an authentication token. This method must be called without the auth parameter in the JSON-RPC request, and is only available to unauthenticated users who do not belong to any user group with enabled multi-factor authentication.

user.logout.title: user.logout
user.logout.description: Log out of the API and invalidate the current authentication token. The method accepts an empty array.

user.resettotp.title: user.resettotp
user.resettotp.description: Reset user TOTP secrets. User sessions for the specified users will also be deleted (except for the user sending the request).

userdirectory.delete.title: userdirectory.delete
userdirectory.delete.description: Delete user directories. A user directory cannot be deleted when it is directly used for at least one user group. The default LDAP user directory cannot be deleted when authentication.ldap_configured is set to 1 or when there are more user directories left.

userdirectory.get.title: userdirectory.get
userdirectory.get.description: Retrieve user directories according to the given parameters.

userdirectory.test.title: userdirectory.test
userdirectory.test.description: Test user directory connection settings. Also allows testing what configured data matches the user directory settings for user provisioning (e.g., what user role, user groups, user medias will be assigned to the user); for this type of test the request should be made for a user directory that has provision_status set to enabled. Since userdirectory.get does not return the bind_password field, userdirectoryid and/or bind_password should be supplied.

userdirectory.update.title: userdirectory.update
userdirectory.update.description: Update existing user directories. The userdirectoryid property must be defined for each user directory; all other properties are optional. Only the passed properties will be updated, all others will remain unchanged.

usergroup.delete.title: usergroup.delete
usergroup.delete.description: Delete user groups. Note: the deprovisioned users group (disabled_usrgrpid in Authentication) cannot be deleted.

usergroup.get.title: usergroup.get
usergroup.get.description: Retrieve user groups according to the given parameters.

usermacro.delete.title: usermacro.delete
usermacro.delete.description: Delete host macros. Params are the IDs of the host macros to delete.

usermacro.deleteglobal.title: usermacro.deleteglobal
usermacro.deleteglobal.description: Delete global macros. Params are the IDs of the global macros to delete.

usermacro.get.title: usermacro.get
usermacro.get.description: Retrieve host and global macros according to the given parameters.

usermacro.update.title: usermacro.update
usermacro.update.description: Update existing host macros. The hostmacroid property must be defined for each host macro; all other properties are optional and only the passed properties will be updated.

usermacro.updateglobal.title: usermacro.updateglobal
usermacro.updateglobal.description: Update existing global macros. The globalmacroid property must be defined for each global macro; all other properties are optional and only the passed properties will be updated.

valuemap.get.title: valuemap.get
valuemap.get.description: Retrieve value maps according to the given parameters.
